balance.caption: Start with balance
balance.detail: Open Add balance and follow the current payment order.

credit.caption: Wait for credit
credit.detail: Continue when your account balance updates.

billing.caption: Choose how to pay
billing.detail: Hourly access or traffic billing: choose the mode that fits.

access.caption: Activate your access
access.detail: Enable an hourly squad, or use eligible traffic nodes directly with balance.

routing.caption: Make the route yours
routing.detail: Custom route needed? Choose entry, template and exit in DIY Center.

applied.caption: Save. Wait for Applied.
applied.detail: Keep the defaults if you do not need custom routing.

client.caption: Get an official client
client.detail: Download a current Mihomo- or Xray-based client from its official project.

compatibility.caption: Match client and node
compatibility.detail: Check Subscription compatibility for the client and node you will use.

import.caption: Copy. Paste. Save.
import.detail: Paste your current Subscription link into the client’s subscription URL field.

refresh.caption: Update the node list
refresh.detail: No link yet? Wait for first sync. Refresh after access changes.

connect.caption: Choose a node. Connect.
connect.detail: Start the client and enable its system proxy or VPN/TUN as needed.

verify.caption: Open a site. You’re ready.
verify.detail: If access fails, check balance, node availability and subscription updates.

entry.caption: Start with the right entry
entry.detail: Use an encrypted client through a China Optimized entry for overseas access.

conditions.caption: Your route shapes speed
conditions.detail: Premium transit alone does not bypass filtering.

international.caption: Reach across regions
international.detail: International transit connects overseas locations and onward routes.

reputation.caption: Speed is one measure
reputation.detail: A data-center exit may be classified as hosting; the actual IP matters.

broadband.caption: Choose a local ISP exit
broadband.detail: Broadband exits provide a local ISP environment for everyday use.

services.caption: The service still decides
services.detail: An ISP exit cannot prove residency or guarantee account acceptance.

pairing.caption: Pair entry and exit
pairing.detail: Where supported, pair an optimized entry with an International or Broadband exit.

destination.caption: The final exit is visible
destination.detail: The destination sees the final exit’s public IP.

compare.caption: Compare on your connection
compare.detail: Try available nodes from your own network at the time you usually connect.

choose.caption: Choose for your task
choose.detail: Use the entry for connectivity and the exit for the destination you need.

invoice.caption: Open the current invoice
invoice.detail: Use the token, network and receiving address shown on this order.

network.caption: Match both ends
network.detail: Select the invoice’s network in your wallet or exchange before sending.

deadline.caption: Keep every decimal
deadline.detail: The received amount must match the order before its payment window closes.

provider.caption: Check the fee mode
provider.detail: Bybit and other providers may deduct fees from the amount you enter.

withdrawal.caption: Deducted fee? Add it.
withdrawal.detail: Enter the displayed order amount plus the provider’s current deducted fee.

preview.caption: Preview the exact arrival
preview.detail: Entered amount minus deducted fees must equal the order amount. Example figures only.

gas.caption: Fee charged separately?
gas.detail: If entered amount already means amount received, enter the order amount; reserve fees separately.

resources.caption: Leave room for gas
resources.detail: Wallets may sponsor or convert fees; follow the current estimate.

confirmation.caption: Sent. Confirming. Confirmed.
confirmation.detail: Wait for on-chain confirmation and payment processing.

credited.caption: Check your balance
credited.detail: Still pending or mismatched? Ask support before sending another payment.

support.caption: Send useful payment details
support.detail: DM the bot with the order number, network and transaction hash.

secrets.caption: Wallet secrets stay private
secrets.detail: Support does not need your seed phrase or private key.

cgnat.caption: One IP. Many users.
cgnat.detail: Carrier-grade NAT can put many households or mobile users behind one public IPv4.

neighbors.caption: Sharing alone is ordinary
neighbors.detail: Shared addresses are common; IP-wide blocks can still affect innocent users.

node.caption: A dedicated IP per node
node.detail: Each TX node has a standalone public IP, outside upstream shared NAT.

members.caption: Members share that exit
members.detail: The node’s IP is shared by its members, not assigned privately per person.

controls.caption: Keep sharing controlled
controls.detail: Member, protocol and connection controls protect shared capacity.

boundaries.caption: Keep avoidable load out
boundaries.detail: These restrictions reduce load and reputation risk; they cannot remove all risk.

signals.caption: Services combine many signals
signals.detail: IP alone does not determine whether a service accepts an account.

behavior.caption: Your use also matters
behavior.detail: Follow the destination’s rules and avoid abnormal automated activity.

limits.caption: Expect service-side checks
limits.detail: Verification and restrictions remain possible on any exit.

support.caption: Tell us what changed
support.detail: Message the bot with the node, affected service and time.

everyday.caption: Browse. Stream. Play.
everyday.detail: Everyday use is welcome within your access and limits.

platforms.caption: Work. Create. Keep it fair.
platforms.detail: Legitimate social, e-commerce and AI work must follow each platform’s rules.

private.caption: Keep access personal
private.detail: Do not resell access, share it onward or expose an open proxy.

subscription.caption: Treat your link as a key
subscription.detail: Keep subscription links out of public chats and screenshots.

automation.caption: Keep bot farms out
automation.detail: Bulk sign-ups and crawlers risk other members’ access.

torrents.caption: Keep shared capacity useful
torrents.detail: BT/PT, spam and network attacks are prohibited.

abuse.caption: Protect everyone on the route
abuse.detail: No malware, credential attacks or automated connection flooding.

controls.caption: Fair use has controls
controls.detail: Protocol recognition and connection limits help protect shared capacity.

limits.caption: Rules apply throughout
limits.detail: Undetected prohibited traffic is still prohibited.

support.caption: Normal use affected? Tell us.
support.detail: Message the bot with the node, time and action that failed.

choice.caption: Fit access to your day
choice.detail: Choose hourly or traffic billing where offered.

terms.caption: See what triggers a charge
terms.detail: Check the displayed price and limits; watch the billing tutorials.

project.caption: Built and maintained here
project.detail: Our project connects the member interface, billing and X-Node.

improve.caption: A direct line to improvements
improve.detail: We can investigate issues and improve our software directly.

quality.caption: People behind the service
quality.detail: We maintain the service and investigate reported quality problems.

diagnose.caption: Help us see the issue
diagnose.detail: Include the node, time, client and affected service in your report.

recover.caption: Get help when things fail
recover.detail: Networks can fail and destinations can restrict access; we investigate and help.

privacy.caption: Live observations are transient
privacy.detail: Live connection observations are not retained as browsing history.

records.caption: Keep accounting clear
records.detail: Necessary account, payment and traffic-accounting records remain.

support.caption: One message starts support
support.detail: DM the bot for setup, payment or access help.
